scripts.build: npm run data:generate && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
scripts.verify:sites: node tools/verify/check-domains.mjs tools/verify/dmo-candidates.json tools/verify/dmo-verified.json && node tools/verify/select-sites.mjs tools/verify/dmo-verified.json tools/verify/dmo-selection.json && node tools/verify/write-sites-seed.mjs tools/verify/dmo-selection.json
scripts.verify:hotels: node tools/verify/check-hotels.mjs tools/verify/hotels-verified.json && node tools/verify/write-hotels-seed.mjs tools/verify/hotels-verified.json
scripts.verify:hotels-geo: node tools/verify/audit-hotels.mjs tools/verify/hotels-audit.json && node tools/verify/apply-audit.mjs tools/verify/hotels-audit.json
